trello.name: Document security incident and file in security log
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Deadline: This week. Action: Create a detailed incident write-up for the support ticket injection attempt. The document must include the raw ticket content (quoted verbatim), a description of how the summarizer reacted (garbled output with 'URGENT'), relevant timestamps, and a severity assessment. File this record in the official security log.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against injection attacks
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Action: Implement a sanitization layer in the ticket parser to handle quoted customer content as data. Specific steps include: 1) Add delimiters for customer content, 2) Implement an instruction-pattern filter to strip or neutralize instruction-like content, 3) Create a regression test fixture using the specific malicious ticket to ensure the summary remains clean, 4) Add an evaluation suite that runs injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy.

trello.name: Investigate password reset issues for user jdoe443
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Action: Check password reset email delivery logs for the last week to determine if resets are broken generally or specifically for user 'jdoe443'. Verify if 'jdoe443' is a real account or a burner. If resets are broken, escalate to a separate incident; if it is a burner account, close the inquiry.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts for quarterly review
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Deadline: Thursday. Action: Compile and send to Grace a list of all service accounts created since May. This is required input for the quarterly access review which is due on Friday.
